game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: legenda411
quote: An absolute masterpiece and the Game of the Year, as well as the best game of the next decade. You won't find a world this detailed and well-crafted anywhere else. Just look at the vehicle damage mechanics, which have been improved since the fourth game. Probably the best and most optimized game at launch (PS5 Pro). I won't list all the positives so I don't spoil the experience for you. Go and see for yourself. I hope Rockstar continues to delight us with quality content for years to come and doesn't leave the PC version behind.
